余振东在云市是做建材批发和物流生意的，生意做得很大，自然是不差钱的。

“小姜，别让余叔生气啊！我知道王寻这小子的事，老王给了你一百万的感谢费，咱老余也不差事，就按这个数来！你要不把卡号发来，余叔可是真的要生气了！”

吴姜又推辞了几句，见余振东态度坚决，知道拗不过，只好压着心里的窃喜，将卡号给余振东发了过去。

等收到了转账到账的短信，吴姜才猛地想起一件事来，昨晚光顾着捉拿厉鬼，居然忘了那只厉鬼寄居的玉佩！

那玉佩既然能让厉鬼藏身，想来应该是和聚灵吊坠一样的法器，这可不能就这么白白浪费了。

玉佩应该在昨晚那栋别墅里，可是想到昨晚那场面，吴姜就忍不住有些发窘。

但他又舍不得就此放弃，只好向余振东打听，认不认识那栋别墅的业主。

吴姜一说别墅的位置和楼栋号，余振东就知道说的是谁家了，简单和吴姜说了一下那家业主的情况。

吴姜大概了解了情况后，就和大家提出了告辞。

余振东本来想陪吴姜一起上门的，但被吴姜拒绝了，他们一家子今天的事情还不少，还要去感谢普安寺众多大师的收留，就不麻烦他们了。

临走前，他看向王寻，询问王寻的打算。

“姜哥，不用管我了，我跟安妹到时一起回学校就行了。”王寻笑着说道。

吴姜点了点头，他也不是很乐意王寻和他一起，实在是这小子太话痨了。

和几人告别后，吴姜再次来到了昨晚的别墅区。

因为是白天的缘故，吴姜这次倒是顺利的进去了，只是到了地方，无论怎么按门铃，里面都没有任何回应。

无奈之下，他只好又将电话打给了余振东。

等余振东回过电话，吴姜这才知道，这家的主人，昨晚连夜就去了医院，

等吴姜到了医院，按余振东发来的信息，刚找到病房门口，还没敲门，就听到里面传来激烈的争吵声，还有女人委屈的哭泣声。

吴姜站在门口，听了一会儿，就明白怎么回事了。

Yu Zhendong is engaged in building materials wholesale and logistics business in Yunshi. The business is very large, so he is naturally not short of money.

"Xiao Jiang, don't make Uncle Yu angry! I know what happened to this boy Wang Xun. Old Wang gave you one million as a thank-you fee. We, Old Yu, don't have any errands, so we'll just give you this amount! If you don't send me your card number, Uncle Yu will really be angry!"

Wu Jiang declined a few more words. Seeing Yu Zhendong's resolute attitude, he knew he couldn't resist, so he had to suppress the secret joy in his heart and sent the card number to Yu Zhendong.

When Wu Jiang received the text message that the money had been transferred, he suddenly remembered something. He was busy catching the ghost last night, but he actually forgot the jade pendant where the ghost lived!

Since that jade pendant can hide evil ghosts, it must be the same magic weapon as the spirit-gathering pendant. This cannot be wasted like this.

The jade pendant should be in the villa last night, but thinking of the scene last night, Wu Jiang couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed.

But he was reluctant to give up, so he had to ask Yu Zhendong if he knew the owner of that villa.

As soon as Wu Jiang told him the location and building number of the villa, Yu Zhendong knew who he was talking about, and briefly told Wu Jiang about the owner's situation.

After Wu Jiang roughly understood the situation, he said goodbye to everyone.

Yu Zhendong originally wanted to accompany Wu Jiang to the house, but Wu Jiang refused. Their family had a lot to do today, and they had to thank the many masters of Pu'an Temple for taking them in, so I wouldn't bother them.

Before leaving, he looked at Wang Xun and asked Wang Xun about his plan.

"Brother Jiang, don't worry about me. An Mei and I will go back to school together when the time comes." Wang Xun said with a smile.

Wu Jiang nodded. He was not very happy for Wang Xun to be with him. This guy was too talkative.

After saying goodbye to a few people, Wu Jiang came to the villa area last night again.

Because it was daytime, Wu Jiang went in smoothly this time, but when he got there, no matter how he pressed the doorbell, there was no response from inside.

In desperation, he had to call Yu Zhendong again.

When Yu Zhendong returned the call, Wu Jiang knew that the owner of the house had gone to the hospital overnight.

When Wu Jiang arrived at the hospital, according to the message sent by Yu Zhendong, he just found the door of the ward and before knocking on the door, he heard a fierce quarrel and a woman's grievance crying inside.

Wu Jiang stood at the door and after listening for a while, he understood what was going on.
